plugin_read_only: You do not have permission to change this plugin's settings. Shown read-only.

settings.title: PayPal Settings
settings.description: Configure PayPal REST app credentials, accepted currencies and webhooks.
settings.guide_step1: 1. In the PayPal Developer Dashboard (developer.paypal.com) > Apps & Credentials, create an app and enter its Client ID and Secret below.
settings.guide_step2: 2. In the same app's Webhooks, add the webhook URL below (with the listed events) and enter the Webhook ID.
settings.guide_step3: 3. In Ecommerce settings > Language & Currency, add foreign currencies (USD, EUR, ...), then pick the ones PayPal should accept below.
settings.guide_step4: 4. In Ecommerce settings > Order settings > Payment methods, enable "PayPal". It only appears at checkout for foreign-currency orders.
settings.is_sandbox_hint: While on, only test payments are made with sandbox credentials. Turn it off before going live.
settings.client_id_hint: Found in the app details under Apps & Credentials.
settings.client_secret_hint: Keep this secret. It is masked after saving.
settings.webhook_id_hint: Used to verify webhook signatures. If blank, all webhooks are rejected (checkout still works).
settings.currencies_hint: PayPal appears at checkout only for orders in the selected currencies. By default every currency PayPal supports is selected.
settings.currencies_in_country_note: * BRL, CNY and MYR can only be received by PayPal accounts registered in that country.
settings.currencies_krw_note: PayPal does not support KRW, so PayPal never appears for KRW orders. Selecting a currency your store does not offer has no effect.
settings.brand_name_hint: Store name shown on the PayPal approval page. Leave blank to use the PayPal account name.
settings.webhook_url_hint: Register this URL in your PayPal app's Webhooks. The webhook completes the payment even if the buyer closes the window after approving.
settings.redirect_success_url_hint: {shopBase} becomes the storefront address and {orderId} the order number. A full URL (https://...) also works.
settings.redirect_fail_url_hint: {shopBase} becomes the storefront address. Error details (error, message, orderId) are appended as query parameters.
settings.conn_hint: Checks PayPal authentication and webhook registration with the saved settings. Save first if you changed the keys.
settings.conn_request_failed: Could not run the connection test. Please try again shortly.
settings.conn_credentials_missing: Client ID / Secret for the current mode are empty
settings.conn_credentials_invalid: Credentials are invalid (check they match the mode)
settings.conn_credentials_unreachable: Could not reach PayPal (check outbound access from the server)
settings.conn_webhook_not_found: No webhook with this ID in the PayPal app for this mode
settings.conn_webhook_url_mismatch: The webhook URL registered at PayPal differs from this site

error.start_failed: Could not start PayPal checkout. Please try again.
error.untrusted_url: The PayPal address is not valid. The payment was not started.

admin.dashboard_hint: Find the transaction in PayPal Dashboard > Activity by capture ID. Refund through this store's order cancellation/refund.
